# Psalm 101 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Of-David. A-psalm. Steadfast-love and-justice I-will-sing; to-you O-YHWH I-will-sing-praises.

**2** I-will-give-heed to-way blameless — when will-you-come to-me? I-will-walk in-integrity-of my-heart in-midst-of my-house.

**3** Not I-will-set before my-eyes a-thing-of worthlessness; doing-of swerving I-hate; not it-will-cling to-me.

**4** A-heart perverse will-depart from-me; evil not I-will-know.

**5** One-slandering in-secret his-neighbor — him I-will-destroy; one-high-of eyes and-broad-of heart — him not I-can-endure.

**6** My-eyes on the-faithful-of the-land, to-dwell with-me; one-walking in-way blameless — he will-serve-me.

**7** Not will-dwell in-midst-of my-house one-doing deceit; one-speaking lies not will-be-established before my-eyes.

**8** Every-morning I-will-destroy all the-wicked-of the-land, to-cut-off from-city-of YHWH all doers-of iniquity.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **101:2**: 'When will-you-come to-me?' — an abrupt cry in the midst of royal resolves; the king awaits divine presence to fulfill his ethical commitments.

- **101:8**: 'Every-morning' — justice administered daily at the city gate; the king's judicial responsibility is ongoing, not occasional.

— EMET
